changelog: New LSA Leads queue: work Google Local Services Ads leads (from LeadTruffle) right in the dialer — review the conversation, claim-on-open so no two reps take the same lead, and dispositions write back to LeadTruffle (timestamped note + pipeline status + reassignment to the caller)
LSA leads dial from the matching caller ID (Arizona Roofers / AZ Roof Pro) and show the customer's REAL phone pulled from Google even when LeadTruffle only has a masked number
New LSA leads and booked/lost changes now arrive in seconds and the queue refreshes on its own — no manual reload
Company + status filters (Callable default) and a no-phone review flow; queue dropdown replaces the cramped tab bar
Welcome Calls: Deposits On Hold jobs no longer appear in the due queue
